title: Black Friday 2026 UK live deals: the best offers right now
seoTitle: Black Friday 2026 UK: Best Live Deals (Updated Today)
description: The best genuine UK Black Friday 2026 deals live right now, checked three times a day. Tech, home, beauty and toys, with prices compared.
intro:
**Last checked: Wednesday 18 November, 1:53pm.** The three standouts right now: the **Kindle Paperwhite Signature Edition at £139.99** (still its record-low price), the **Ninja Foodi Dual Zone AF300UK air fryer at £119.99**, below last year's Black Friday price, and new this lunchtime, the **Dyson V8 Origin cordless vacuum at £199.99**, £130 off. All three are at Amazon.

Black Friday 2026 is on Friday 27 November, and Amazon's Black Friday Week starts tomorrow (19 November) and runs to 30 November. We check this page three times a day and remove anything that has sold out or gone back up. This lunchtime we added the Dyson V8 Origin, the standard Kindle at £119.99 and the Sonos Move 2 at £359, and took off the Echo Spot and Sony WH-1000XM4, which are likely to drop further when Black Friday Week starts. Prices were reported on 17 and 18 November, so check the price on the retailer's page before you buy.

deals.name: Amazon Kindle Paperwhite Signature Edition (2024, 32GB)
deals.note: Wireless charging, an auto-adjusting light and 32GB of storage. £139.99 is the lowest price it has been. See our [Kindle Black Friday guide](/guides/kindle-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Ninja Foodi Dual Zone 7.6L Air Fryer (AF300UK)
deals.note: The two-drawer Ninja most families buy. It was £125 to £128 last Black Friday, so this already beats it. More in our [air fryer Black Friday guide](/guides/air-fryer-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Dyson V8 Origin Cordless Vacuum
deals.note: Dyson's lightest-on-the-wallet cordless at £130 off, listed in Amazon's early Black Friday deals on 18 November. Fine for flats and quick tidy-ups. More in our [Dyson Black Friday guide](/guides/dyson-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Amazon Ember 50-inch 4K TV
deals.note: Amazon's own 4K TV with Fire TV built in, at its lowest price yet. A sensible bedroom or second-room TV. More in our [TV Black Friday guide](/guides/tv-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Beats Powerbeats Fit Wireless Earbuds
deals.note: Half price. Secure wingtip fit for running and the gym, with active noise cancelling and quick pairing with iPhones. Reported this morning (18 November).

deals.name: Ring Battery Video Doorbell + Ring Indoor Camera bundle
deals.note: A wire-free doorbell plus a plug-in indoor camera for about what the doorbell alone usually costs. The 'was' price adds the two list prices together, but £40 for both is still excellent.

deals.name: Lancôme La Vie Est Belle Eau de Parfum gift set
deals.note: The Perfume Shop lists it at £56.24 after its 25% off, a saving of £44.76. One of the best-selling women's gift sets; check the bottle size on the listing. See our [perfume gift sets guide](/guides/perfume-gift-sets-black-friday-2026/).

deals.name: Amazon Fire TV Stick 4K
deals.note: Adds 4K streaming apps to any TV with an HDMI port. Less than half price; last year's low was about £25, so it could dip a little more from 19 November.

deals.name: Amazon Kindle (2024, 16GB)
deals.note: The basic Kindle with a glare-free screen and adjustable light, £30 off (reported 18 November). The Paperwhite above is worth the extra £20 for its bigger, waterproof screen. See our [Kindle Black Friday guide](/guides/kindle-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Blink Mini 2K+ Indoor Security Camera
deals.note: A small plug-in camera for pets or a front room, with sharper 2K video than the original Mini. A record low.

deals.name: Shark Stratos Cordless Vacuum
deals.note: Shark's top cordless with anti-hair-wrap brushes and odour control, at under half its launch price. See our [Shark Black Friday guide](/guides/shark-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Ninja Crispi Portable Glass Air Fryer
deals.note: Cooks in glass dishes you can serve from and store leftovers in. Under last year's Black Friday price of £117. Good for one or two people.

deals.name: Tefal Easy Fry XXL 11L Air Fryer
deals.note: A huge single basket that fits a whole chicken, at its lowest price since Prime Day. Better for big batches than the two-drawer Ninja above. See our [air fryer Black Friday guide](/guides/air-fryer-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: De'Longhi Magnifica Evo Next Bean-to-Cup Coffee Machine
deals.note: Grinds beans fresh and froths milk at a touch. Compare it with the alternatives in our [coffee machine Black Friday guide](/guides/coffee-machine-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Rabanne Invictus Eau de Toilette gift set
deals.note: About 30% off a popular men's set, in The Perfume Shop's Black Friday sale.

deals.name: Nothing Ear (3a) Wireless Earbuds
deals.note: Noise-cancelling earbuds with a clear, punchy sound for £40 off. A cheaper alternative to AirPods; see our [AirPods Black Friday guide](/guides/airpods-black-friday-deals-2026/) for Apple prices.

deals.name: Beats Studio Pro Wireless Over-Ear Headphones
deals.note: Noise-cancelling over-ears with USB-C audio. A good alternative to the Sony XM4 if you use an iPhone. Reported this morning (18 November).

deals.name: Sonos Move 2 Portable Speaker
deals.note: A big-sounding battery speaker that works on Wi-Fi at home and Bluetooth in the garden. £90 off at Amazon, reported 18 November.

deals.name: Microsoft Surface Laptop (13.8-inch, Snapdragon X2 Plus, 16GB, 512GB)
deals.note: A thin, long-lasting Windows laptop with £550 off. Check the exact spec on the listing, as Amazon sells several versions.

deals.name: Revlon Salon One-Step Hair Dryer and Volumiser
deals.note: Dries and adds volume in one go with a round brush head. £25 is a record low and a good stocking filler. More haircare in our [ghd Black Friday guide](/guides/ghd-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Oral-B iO Series 3 Electric Toothbrush
deals.note: The cheapest way into Oral-B's iO range. Ignore the £175 'was' price; around £50 is a fair price. See our [Oral-B Black Friday guide](/guides/oral-b-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Philips OneBlade 360 Face Trimmer and Shaver
deals.note: Trims, edges and shaves with one flexible blade. A dependable gift under £40.

deals.name: Ninja CREAMi Soft Serve
deals.note: Soft-serve and scoopable ice cream in one machine, £60 off. Creami prices often dip again in Black Friday Week. See our [Ninja Black Friday guide](/guides/ninja-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: LEGO Star Wars Advent Calendar 2026
deals.note: It needs to arrive by 1 December, so there's no point waiting. Every set is in our [Lego advent calendar 2026 guide](/guides/lego-advent-calendar-2026/).

deals.name: Nintendo Switch 2 + Switch Sports Resort + Zelda: Ocarina of Time bundle
deals.note: The console with two games for £60 less than buying separately. See our [Switch 2 Black Friday guide](/guides/nintendo-switch-2-black-friday-deals-2026/) for other bundles.

body:
## Tech

The best tech deals right now are on Amazon's own devices: the Kindle Paperwhite Signature, the Ring and Blink camera bundles and the Fire TV Stick 4K. The standard Kindle is £119.99 too. Echo speakers usually drop further when Amazon's Black Friday Week starts on 19 November, so wait for those. For laptops, the Surface Laptop at £899 is the biggest cut we've seen. Amazon's own Ember 50-inch 4K TV is at its lowest price yet at £269.99. For headphones, Beats Powerbeats Fit earbuds are half price at £99 and the Beats Studio Pro are £159 and the Sonos Move 2 portable speaker is £359.

More: [Kindle](/guides/kindle-black-friday-deals-2026/), [Ring doorbells](/guides/ring-doorbell-black-friday-deals-2026/), [AirPods](/guides/airpods-black-friday-deals-2026/), [TVs](/guides/tv-black-friday-deals-2026/) and [Amazon Black Friday 2026](/guides/amazon-black-friday-2026-uk/).

## Home & kitchen

Ninja's air fryers are already at or below last year's Black Friday prices, so there's little reason to wait. Coffee machines are well discounted too (the Sage Barista Express is down to £499.99 at Currys, but that's about £50 above its record low, so we've dropped it), the Tefal XXL air fryer is £109.99 at Amazon, and the Shark Stratos at £199 (Currys) and the Dyson V8 Origin at £199.99 (Amazon) are the standout vacuum deals. The Dyson V15 Detect Absolute deals have ended (it's back to about £649), so we've removed it; see our [Dyson V15 guide](/guides/dyson-v15-deals-uk/) for the price to wait for.

More: [air fryers](/guides/air-fryer-black-friday-deals-2026/), [Ninja](/guides/ninja-black-friday-deals-2026/), [coffee machines](/guides/coffee-machine-black-friday-deals-2026/), [Dyson](/guides/dyson-black-friday-deals-2026/) and [Shark](/guides/shark-black-friday-deals-2026/).

## Beauty

Grooming and haircare gifts are the safest buys: the Oral-B iO3 and Philips OneBlade are at fair prices that rarely go lower, and the Revlon One-Step volumiser is at a record-low £25 at Currys. Perfume gift sets are now properly discounted: The Perfume Shop has Lancôme La Vie Est Belle at £56.24 and Rabanne Invictus at £49.99, and Superdrug's Black Friday fragrance event runs until 1 December. Amazon sells most of the same sets, so [compare Amazon's perfume gift set prices](https://www.amazon.co.uk/s?k=perfume+gift+set) before you buy.

More: [perfume gift sets](/guides/perfume-gift-sets-black-friday-2026/), [ghd](/guides/ghd-black-friday-deals-2026/) and [Oral-B](/guides/oral-b-black-friday-deals-2026/).

## Toys & gifts

Advent calendars need to arrive by 1 December, so buy those now. For toys, Hamleys is running its own Black Friday event, and our guide shows what's worth buying there.

More: [Hamleys Black Friday 2026](/guides/hamleys-black-friday-2026/), [Lego](/guides/lego-black-friday-deals-2026/), [Lego advent calendars](/guides/lego-advent-calendar-2026/) and [Nintendo Switch 2](/guides/nintendo-switch-2-black-friday-deals-2026/).

## How we pick these deals

Every price comes from the retailer or a trusted deals source dated today or yesterday. We compare it with price history and last year's Black Friday prices, and we leave out deals where the 'was' price is inflated. When Amazon matches the cheapest shop, we link Amazon. Many Amazon prices need Prime from 19 November; our [Prime free trial guide](/guides/amazon-prime-free-trial-black-friday-2026/) explains how to time a trial.

### When is Black Friday 2026 in the UK?

Friday 27 November, with Cyber Monday on 30 November. Our [when is Black Friday 2026 guide](/guides/when-is-black-friday-2026-uk/) lists every retailer's dates.

### Should I buy now or wait for Black Friday?

If a deal here is marked 'Lowest price', it's already at or below last year's Black Friday price, so buy it. Items marked 'Good price' could still fall a little in the final week.

### How often is this page updated?

Three times a day, every day until Cyber Monday. Deals that end or go up in price are removed.

See [every Black Friday 2026 guide](/black-friday/) for brand-by-brand prices to wait for.
